correctness.rationale: Exact odd-binomial harmonic identity proved by two integrals; 2-adic logarithm vanishes at -1; factorial units U_a converge by residue-cycle products; the tail estimate uniformly bounds valuations by r-1-log2((a+1)(r+Delta)), so termwise limit is legitimate; Legendre digit-sum identity gives the exact product formula. The standalone finite checker independently corroborates arithmetic for 24 parameter pairs and 96 approximants.

residual_risks: An equivalent limit may exist in literature under a harmonic-sum or odd-partial-Stirling normalization; targeted search cannot establish uniqueness.

value.rationale: The earlier literature explicitly motivates convergence at eventual-periodic 2-adic inputs beyond the proved nonnegative inputs. x=-1 is the simplest negative periodic input. The theorem gives an exact nonzero/zero classification and factorization simultaneously for every fixed offset Delta and multiplier a, with a different logarithmic cancellation mechanism from the positive-input formula; the family is mathematically natural and answers a concrete boundary case without claiming the entire conjecture.
